name: lastChaseTime
meaning: g_gameTime when Sam last answered msg 0x480 (alert level 2); checkpoints are frozen for 0x2000 ticks (2.0 s) after it

name: entries
meaning: the eight checkpoint entries; the first entryCount are populated

name: jointMask
meaning: bit i: entry i only applies when Wolf and sheep are in the SAME entry

name: disableEarlierMask
meaning: bit i: reaching entry i clears all earlier entries and sends the sheep msg 0x988

name: sam
meaning: Sam object found at init (may be null)
